services.desc: The catalog should be used as a guide in planning what classes to take each semester to meet requirements for graduation. The Casper College Catalog is the official reference for the college’s academic programs, courses, and academic procedures. Ready to plan your semester? Use our interactive class schedule tool to explore upcoming course offerings, search for specific subjects, and filter options by term or delivery format. Whether you are building a full-time schedule or looking for a single class to fit your busy routine, you can easily find the sections that match your goals.
